request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: head-and-shoulders bust portrait for a game interface, level three-quarter view, the character turned slightly to the right (south-east) and looking at the viewer, head and upper chest filling most of the square, centred on a transparent background. The bust ends cleanly at the chest; nothing else is in the image.

Faction: a cheerful chocolatier's kingdom of living sweets, rich, glossy and silly. Its fixed colours: glossy dark chocolate, colour #4a2412, and milk chocolate, colour #7a4526, as the dark anchor on every piece (a dipped half, a shield, a glaze, boots, a roof); golden caramel and toffee, colour #e0a040; vanilla cream and marshmallow white, colour #fff1d0; pale biscuit wafer; a few small jewel-candy accents in amber, mint green and cherry pink; one hard pure white highlight on every glossy surface.
layers.negative: crimson, red, magenta, hot pink, neon pink, purple, violet, all-pink body, pink blob, pastel pink frosting everywhere, metal armour, steel, iron, sword, fur, bone, skull, scary, horror, realistic, banana guard, giant humanoid guardian robot with a gumball head, pink-haired princess, lab coat with a crown, peppermint butler, lemon-headed figure, cartoon show character

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute character portrait with a huge round head and big friendly eyes, the same chunky body language as the map piece, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels.
layers.negative: full body, legs, feet, standing figure, pedestal, base, plinth, frame, border, circle background, badge, medallion, vignette, background scenery, second character, crowd, text

layers.text: Subject: Gingerbread Giant portrait, a close-up of the head and shoulders of a huge living gingerbread man: a big round head of warm gingerbread brown biscuit, colour #b8703a, edged with a wavy line of white icing, with a face of white icing, two round eyes, two small pink cheeks and a wide determined grin; broad biscuit shoulders edged with white icing, a cream icing bow tie and the top of a row of round gumdrop buttons in mint green and caramel gold; one huge dark chocolate gauntlet fist, colour #4a2412, raised beside the head.
A close-up: the gingerbread man's big round head with its icing grin fills the whole square; no legs and no feet.
